goal: Use one stable synthetic Lucas voice identity for all future French dialogue. Do not regenerate a new identity per line or per scene.

reference_policy.uploaded_lucas_media: Use only for broad non-biometric performance qualities such as rhythm, breath, conversational energy, relaxed presence, articulation feel and general texture. Never use as a biometric cloning target.
reference_policy.validated_project_voices: Use as historical checkpoints only. V16 remains the last user-approved project voice until this anchor is explicitly approved.
reference_policy.v17_v18_v19_v20: Do not use as authoritative identity references unless explicitly re-approved by the user.

future_runtime_rule.identity: After explicit user approval, every new Lucas line must preserve this same anchor identity.
future_runtime_rule.performance: Generate natural French timing and emotion separately when needed, then map only toward the approved synthetic anchor.

approval_rule: Do not promote this candidate to live/runtime until the user explicitly approves it by ear.
